newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends below 5,000 despite Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends below 5,000 despite Dow rise.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 closed below the 5,000 mark for the first time since it rose above the psychologically important level last week, despite an initial rebound on Wall Street, dealers said on Thursday.
The blue chip index shed 12.3 points to close at 4,991.3, as decliners outpaced advancers 53 to 45. Total SEAQ volume registered 676.3 million shares at 1537 GMT.
The Dow was up 20 points when London markets closed, but investors shrugged off the rebound which was sparked by another set of benign inflation data.
